traps.detail: The string 'ICON' resolves three different ways inside the product's OWN bundled masters, and the manifest recorded only two of them. (a) sidecar/services/resolver_masters/bse_instruments.json:3256 -> ["544426","ICON","Icon Facilitators Ltd","MT","INE0Y0E01012","Active"]. (b) us_instruments.json -> ["ICON","Icon Energy Corp"], a US shipping company. (c) us_instruments.json ALSO contains ["ICLR","ICON PLC"] - so 'ICON' is a TICKER for one US company and the NAME of a different US company in the same file. A ticker match and a name match on the same user string land on two different wrong entities, neither of them the Indian company. nse_instruments.json has no ICON row at all. Resolution must be keyed on scrip code 544426 or on exchange scope, never on the bare string.

Screener's annual EPS row reads 940.00 / 1,920.00 / 1,760.00 / 7.76 / 5.62 INR for FY22-FY26 while net profit runs 0.94 / 1.92 / 1.76 / 4.47 / 4.42 INR crore. The EPS is computed against each year's OWN year-end share count, which went 10,000 shares (equity capital INR 0.01 crore) -> 57,59,600 (INR 5.76 crore, pre-IPO capitalisation in FY25) -> 78,59,600 (INR 7.86 crore, post-IPO FY26). Any EPS CAGR, PEG, EPS-surprise or 'earnings collapse' signal on this series is pure noise: FY25 EPS is DOWN 99.6% against FY24 in a year profit ROSE 154%. This is the exact 1000x small-cap misread class the R15 brief cites Perplexity Finance for - the numbers are all individually 'correct' on the page.

As a BSE SME scrip this company files HALF-YEARLY, not quarterly. Only four result periods exist in total (Sep-2024, Mar-2025, Sep-2025, Mar-2026) and only two shareholding periods (Sep-2025, Mar-2026). A panel or pipeline that takes 'the last 4 quarters' silently ingests TWO YEARS of data; a TTM built from four periods double-counts; a QoQ change is a half-on-half change; a 'missing quarters' validator will flag a fully-compliant filer as delinquent. Screener labels the block 'Half Yearly Results' - the label is there to be read.

INDmoney prints 'P/E Ratio (TTM): 0', 'EPS (TTM): 0' and 'Book Value: 0' for a company with FY26 EPS of INR 5.62 and a book value of INR 45.57 (https://www.indmoney.com/stocks/icon-facilitators-ltd-share-price). Numeric ingestion without a null check yields a zero-earnings, zero-book-value company - and a P/E of 0 sorts to the TOP of a cheapness screen. The same page's 'Dividend Yield: 0' is a TRUE zero, so the source is not uniformly unreliable: a blanket 'treat 0 as null' rule would be wrong here too.

INDmoney prints 'Last Price: INR 63.50' - which is exactly the day LOW it prints on the same page - while Groww and screener both close at 64.15 / 64.2. INDmoney's own market cap of INR 50.42 crore divided by its own share count of 78,59,600 gives INR 64.15, so the page is internally contradictory: its market cap uses 64.15 while its headline price says 63.50. A differ that picks the headline price from this source reports a 1% price error that no cross-source check on market cap would catch.

The headline 'ROCE 23.3%' cannot be attributed to a year from the page: the Ratios row renders as 45.94 / 34.42 / 48.23 / 23.30 / blank across the Mar-2022..Mar-2026 columns, which reads as an FY25 value, while the arithmetic reconciles to FY26 on average capital employed (EBIT 6.32 / avg CE 27.13 = 23.3%). Either way, a headline ratio strip that may be showing a year-old number without saying so is a data-trust defect, and a pipeline that stamps it with today's as_of date is publishing a stale figure as current.

ROE reads 30% (5y) -> 27% (3y) -> 17.9% (last year). The denominator went from INR 0.01 crore of equity capital to INR 35.82 crore of net worth via a pre-IPO capitalisation and a July-2025 IPO. The 'deteriorating returns' story is arithmetic, not operations - operating profit was flat (6.55 -> 6.44) and sales grew 10.6%. An agent that narrates the ROE trend without the capital-structure change is confidently wrong.

News and entity extraction over 'ICON' or 'Icon' will surface ICON plc (NASDAQ:ICLR, the clinical CRO that most finance coverage means by 'ICON'), Icon Energy Corp, and the ordinary English word. A headline-matching pipeline needs the scrip code or the full 'Icon Facilitators' string plus an India scope, and even then 'Facilitators' is a word, not a brand - the company's own site is iconf.in, matching neither the ticker nor the legal name.
